description:
Analytic NLinear-style forecaster with training-only fitting and per-horizon shrinkage.
- Pool every neuron and window: for each (example, neuron), form a 64-D history vector and a 32-D target.
- Subtract the last observed frame from both history and target to learn future deltas.
- Fit a shared temporal affine map (64→32) with ridge regularization (alpha=1.0) and an unpenalized bias using closed-form normal equations on training data only.
- Calibrate a per-horizon shrinkage factor gamma (size 32) by least-squares mixing against the naive "repeat last frame" baseline, clipped to [0,1] for stability.
- Predict on test: subtract last frame, apply the affine map, shrink deltas by gamma, and add the last frame back. If any numerical issue occurs, fall back to repeating the last input frame.
- Deterministic, NumPy-only, vectorized across all neurons and windows; returns finite outputs with shape (len(test_x), 32, 256).
